description: Phase 5: formalized trust tiers with measurable graduation criteria. Each tier defines what the system may do autonomously and what evidence is required to reach it.

0.name: supervised
0.description: All self-mod proposals require human approval. No auto-deploy, no sandbox execution.

graduation_criteria.note: System must demonstrate basic health before any autonomous action.

1.name: sandbox_explorer
1.description: Auto-deploy to sandbox copy + auto-rollback on regression. Human consulted for production deploy.

graduation_criteria.note: 10 consecutive clean proposals with no rollbacks in 14 days.

2.name: production_deployer
2.description: Auto-deploy to production for narrowly-scoped skill categories with proven track record. Human consulted for architectural changes.

graduation_criteria.note: 20 consecutive clean proposals with no rollbacks in 30 days. Production deploy restricted to skills with proven calibration and zero recent failures.

3.name: architect
3.description: Full autonomy including architectural changes (new modules, multi-file patches). Reserved for mature, proven systems.
3.blocked_actions_note: Immutable-core modification is ALWAYS blocked regardless of tier — enforced unconditionally by check-target.sh's immutable-paths.list. This entry exists to make the block explicit and prevent misreading; the actual enforcement is in check-target.sh, not here.

graduation_criteria.note: 50 consecutive clean proposals with no rollbacks in 90 days. Full trust earned through sustained, measurable performance.

deploy_scope.description: Phase 6: restrict which skills are eligible for auto-deploy at each tier. When a skill is not in the allowed list, proposals targeting it still rank and evaluate but require human approval for deployment regardless of tier.
deploy_scope.tier_2_full_scope: all mutable skills (remove restrictions after proven track record)
